subject.title: fix(cron): cap trigger script tool access

question: How should OpenClaw handle pre-existing trigger-script jobs that lack toolsAllow because their creator's historical tool policy was never persisted?
rationale: A trustworthy cap cannot be reconstructed from legacy rows; preserving them retains the known broad surface, while failing closed can stop existing automation.

options.title: Audit legacy jobs
options.body: Land the forward fix with a doctor or startup audit that lists uncapped triggers and lets operators assign a cap, keep them unrestricted, or disable them.

options.title: Accept forward-only coverage
options.body: Merge while explicitly accepting that historical uncapped triggers remain unrestricted until an authorized edit restamps them.

options.title: Fail closed
options.body: Block legacy uncapped trigger evaluation until an operator assigns policy, accepting immediate compatibility impact.

recommendation.title: Audit legacy jobs
recommendation.body: Land the forward fix with a doctor or startup audit that lists uncapped triggers and lets operators assign a cap, keep them unrestricted, or disable them.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history-backed owner for current cron trigger authoring and the security-versus-upgrade policy choice.
